## item 2.02 — earnings release, exhibit 99.1

[0001002047-26-000003:8k_2_02:5]
Delivers record quarterly net revenues of $2.03 billion, an increase of 30% year-over-year;

[0001002047-26-000003:8k_2_02:7]
Significantly raised fiscal year 2027 revenue and earnings per share guidance

[0001002047-26-000003:8k_2_02:11]
•
Billings of $2.06 billion for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, an increase of 36% year-over-year

[0001002047-26-000003:8k_2_02:15]
“NetApp delivered a record-setting start to the year, exceeding guidance on every metric and achieving our strongest first quarter ever,” said George Kurian, Chief Executive Officer. “Our momentum reflects not only the trust of existing customers but also our success in winning new ones, as organizations choose the NetApp Platform to power their AI and hybrid multi-cloud initiatives. Through continued innovation and strategic investments, we are enabling customers to address their most critical needs and creating lasting value for all stakeholders.”

[0001002047-26-000003:8k_2_02:21]
| The Company provided the following financial guidance for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027: |
| Net revenues are expected to be in the range of: | $2.025 billion - $2.175 billion |
|  | GAAP |  | Non-GAAP |
| Consolidated gross margins are expected to be in the range of: | 66.0% - 67.0% |  | 67.0% - 68.0% |
| Operating margins are expected to be in the range of: | 24.9% - 25.9% |  | 30.9% - 31.9% |
| Earnings per share is expected to be in the range of: | $1.97 - $2.07 |  | $2.54 - $2.64 |

[0001002047-26-000003:8k_2_02:46]
•
NetApp appointed Alvaro Celis as Chief Partner and Ecosystem Officer to lead partner ecosystems, modernize incentive programs, improve partner satisfaction, and drive growth.
